Instead, it provides a high-level analysis of the increasing risk of software supply chain attacks, referencing incidents such as SolarWinds and 3CX, and emphasizes the need for improved vendor security and transparency. behavioral_signatures: Unusual or unauthorized changes to third-party or open-source software dependencies in build pipelines.
Exploitation of vulnerabilities in third-party or open-source software components integrated into production environments.
Compromise of software development pipelines, such as unauthorized access to build systems or code repositories, similar to SolarWinds or 3CX incidents.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Continuously monitor for anomalous activity in software supply chain components, including unexpected dependency changes, unauthorized access to build pipelines, and exploitation of known vulnerabilities in third-party software. Implement robust vendor risk assessments, require software bills of materials (SBOMs) for transparency, and leverage threat intelligence to track emerging supply chain threats. Prioritize timely patching of critical vulnerabilities in third-party and open-source software.
